aggregate_rule: Aggregate is reportable only with both family estimates. A positive aggregate cannot override a material negative Count or Object Extraction delta.

comparators.causal_training_contrast: Treatment minus Control on identical inputs
comparators.preservation: each trained arm minus unchanged V7 on identical inputs

ood.comparison: paired treatment-control exact-grid delta with paired bootstrap interval
ood.material_family_harm: A family-specific Treatment minus Control delta below -1 of 24 is material harm and blocks promotion.
ood.primary_promotion_rule_verbatim: Treatment minus Control must be at least 4 of 48 and its paired-bootstrap 95% lower bound must exceed zero.

preservation_harm_limits.FIXED_TURN_ROTATION_CONTROL: each trained arm minus V7 must be at least -1 of 8
preservation_harm_limits.MARKER_BINDING_CONTROL: each trained arm minus V7 must be at least -1 of 8
preservation_harm_limits.NO_TRANSFORM_RETENTION_CONTROL: each trained arm minus V7 must be at least -1 of 24

target_opening: only after all raw checkpoint/split prediction hashes are frozen
